capabilities: log created, modified and deleted files into notes
insert logs between configurable start and end lines
customize log output with a template using $createdFiles, $deletedFiles and $modifiedFiles
update existing logs instead of inserting duplicates (idempotency)
disambiguation: Not a backup or file-history tool; it only writes a text log of file changes into your notes.
extras: README warns that Start Line and End Line settings must not be left empty; it suggests hiding them by embedding them between headings in daily note templates.
problem: Obsidian does not record which files you created, modified or deleted, so there is no built-in way to keep a running activity log inside your notes.
summary: Activity logger that inserts lists of created, modified and deleted files into notes between configurable start and end lines.
